int model_path_get (  q_head *  qh,
file_info *  root,
char *  path,
pg_mode  pgm
) 
 

add all dirs along a given path to the model and enQ them for reading.

last element in path with be dequeued first (LIFO), as that's the one the user is most likely interested in.

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
qh the queue to place the directories/read-requests in
root the sub-tree of the model, or NULL for top
path the path to examine
pgm the enQ-mode (PG_ENQUEUE enQs all dirs along path for reading, PG_ENQUEUE_LAST enqueues deepest dir in path only)
